name: Aigan Reijou -Ingyaku no Contract-
original_name: 愛玩隷嬢－淫虐のコントラクト－
source:
I, Koji Inada, am a son of ITU (Inada Technical United), no.3 company in the industry.
Hibiki is a girl whose father owns a company that is no.1 in the industry.
Few years ago, I was dumped by Hibiki. Since then, I was always looking for a chance to bring out my revenge.

The chance has arrived suddenly.
The world economy has collapsed, and her father's company went into bankruptcy.
I now got a chance to humiliate Hibiki, with the aid of Himuro-sensei.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ048857.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫稻田浩二，是业界排名第三的企业ITU（稻田技术联合公司）的公子。
响是一名少女，她父亲拥有业界排名第一的企业。
几年前，我被响甩了。从那以后，我一直在寻找报复的机会。

机会突然来临。
世界经济崩溃，她父亲的公司也宣告破产。
如今，在冰室老师的帮助下，我终于得到羞辱响的机会。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ048857.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
